title: Bali Escape
description: Experience the perfect blend of coastal fun and jungle serenity with this 5-day Bali escape.
subtitle: 4 Nights 5 Days | Beaches, Culture, Volcano Views & a Villa Stay
para: Bali offers the perfect mix of beaches, temples, volcano views, waterfalls, and cultural experiences. This package covers both Kuta’s vibrant energy and Ubud’s serene luxury with a private pool villa stay.

overview.subtitle: Beaches, Culture, Volcano Views & Luxury Villa Stay
overview.description-1: Start your journey in Kuta, enjoying beach life, watersports, and cultural evenings with Uluwatu sunsets and Kecak Dance. Continue to Ubud, where you’ll stay in a private pool villa surrounded by Bali’s natural beauty, visiting Tanah Lot, Tegenungan Waterfall, rice terraces, and the famous Bali Swing.
overview.description-2: From volcano views at Kintamani to cultural shopping at Ubud Art Market, this itinerary blends romance, adventure, and culture. Perfect for couples and honeymooners seeking both excitement and tranquility.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali – Leisure Day in Kuta
itinerary.para: Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport (Denpasar). Our representative will warmly welcome you and transfer you to your 4-star hotel in Kuta. After check-in, enjoy the day at leisure. You may explore nearby Kuta Beach, relax at a café, or take a dip in the hotel pool.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Tanjung Benoa Water Sports + Uluwatu Sunset Tour with Kecak Dance
itinerary.para: After breakfast, head to Tanjung Benoa for an exciting morning of water sports. Enjoy a banana boat ride (included) and optionally try jet skiing, parasailing, or sea walking (at extra cost). Later in the afternoon, visit the Uluwatu Temple, perched on a cliff with dramatic ocean views. As the sun sets, witness the iconic Kecak Fire Dance performance, a cultural highlight set against the golden horizon.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Transfer to Ubud + Tanah Lot Temple Tour
itinerary.para: Check out from Kuta and head to Ubud. En route, visit Tanah Lot Temple, one of Bali’s most iconic sea temples. Check in to your luxurious private pool villa and relax.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Full-Day Kintamani Volcano Tour + Ubud Highlights
itinerary.para: Explore central Bali with a full-day sightseeing tour covering Kintamani Volcano, Tegenungan Waterfall, Ubud Art Market, and the famous Bali Swing experience.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Departure from Bali
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from your villa and transfer to the airport for your return flight.

title: Bali Explorer
description: A perfect balance of culture, coastline & adventure.
subtitle: 5 Nights 6 Days | Ubud, Nusa Penida & Kuta Experience
para: This thoughtfully curated Bali itinerary lets you experience the spiritual calm of Ubud, the untouched beauty of Nusa Penida Island, and the lively beach energy of Kuta.

overview.subtitle: Temples, Waterfalls, Volcanoes & Island Adventures
overview.description-1: Start in Ubud with volcano views, waterfalls, swings, and art markets. Continue to Nusa Penida to explore Angel’s Billabong, Broken Beach, and the iconic T-Rex Cliff at Kelingking Beach. End your trip in Kuta with water sports, temples, and sunset shows.
overview.description-2: This 6-day itinerary balances cultural exploration, island adventure, and beach fun, perfect for couples, friends, or families seeking a complete Bali experience.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali – Transfer to Ubud & Leisure
itinerary.para: Welcome to the Island of Gods! Upon landing at Ngurah Rai International Airport (Denpasar), our driver will greet you and transfer you to Ubud, Bali’s peaceful and artistic upland town. After checking into your hotel, the day is yours to relax. You may explore nearby cafés, rice paddies, or just take in the tranquil ambiance.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Kintamani Volcano View + Ubud Highlights
itinerary.para: After breakfast, get ready for a full-day journey through Bali’s cultural and natural gems. The scenic drive will take you to the highlands where you'll witness the magnificent Mount Batur volcano and its serene lake from Kintamani village. Next, experience the thrill of the Bali Swing, and walk through the vibrant lanes of the Ubud Art Market, famous for its handcrafted goods and souvenirs. On the way back, stop at the picturesque Tegenungan Waterfall, surrounded by lush jungle.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Ferry to Nusa Penida – Island Tour
itinerary.para: After an early breakfast, check out and head to Sanur Harbor to catch the speedboat to Nusa Penida, a raw and beautiful island just off the Bali coast. Once you arrive, a private driver will take you on a full-day tour of the island's west coast, visiting some of the most iconic and Instagram-famous sites in all of Bali. Walk along the cliffs at Broken Beach, take pictures at the surreal Angel's Billabong, and be awestruck by the dramatic coastline of Kelingking Beach, also known as the T-Rex Cliff.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Return to Bali Mainland – Tanah Lot Temple
itinerary.para: After breakfast, take the ferry back to Bali mainland and transfer to your hotel in Kuta. Later in the afternoon, visit one of Bali’s most iconic sea temples – Tanah Lot. Perched on a rocky outcrop in the ocean, it's a perfect place to witness a breathtaking sunset.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Water Sports + Uluwatu Sunset & Kecak Dance
itinerary.para: Start your day with excitement at Tanjung Benoa, Bali’s watersports hub. You’ll enjoy a banana boat ride (included), and can also choose to try activities like parasailing, jet skiing, or donut rides (optional, extra cost). In the afternoon, head to Uluwatu Temple, dramatically perched on a sea cliff. As the sun dips into the Indian Ocean, watch the famous Kecak Fire Dance, a mesmerizing cultural performance backed by chants, fire, and ocean views.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Departure from Bali
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from your hotel. You’ll be transferred to Ngurah Rai International Airport for your onward journey. Fly back with a camera full of photos and a heart full of memories from the beaches, temples, and cliffs of Bali.

Return Fast Ferry to/from Nusa Penida

title: Bali Honeymoon Bliss
description: Romance in the Jungle, Love by the Sea & Adventures in Between
subtitle: 6 Nights 7 Days | Ubud Villa, Nusa Penida & Kuta Bliss

overview.subtitle: Romantic Villas, Temples, Beaches & Adventures

overview.description-2: Stay in a private pool villa, enjoy candlelight dinners, explore temples, and indulge in water sports — the perfect blend of love, adventure, and memories.

itinerary.label: Day 1

itinerary.para: Welcome to Bali – the island of love and tranquility! Upon your arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport, you’ll be warmly received and privately transferred to your 4★ private pool villa in Ubud. Take the day to relax, soak in the tropical air, and enjoy the privacy of your villa. A perfect start to your honeymoon.

Then proceed to the Tegenungan Waterfall, and visit the artisan-filled Ubud Village. To top it off, enjoy an exhilarating and photogenic moment on the Bali Swing by Pioneer, surrounded by lush greenery.

itinerary.title: Return to Bali Mainland + Romantic Candlelight Dinner

itinerary.title: Water Sports Fun + Uluwatu Temple Sunset Tour
itinerary.para: Head to Tanjung Benoa for thrilling water sports — Banana Boat, Jet Ski & Parasailing. Later, visit Uluwatu Temple perched on a sea cliff and witness a romantic sunset.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bali
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for departure. Leave with heartwarming memories from your Bali honeymoon.

overview.subtitle: Beaches, Culture & Bliss – A Relaxing Coastal Holiday

overview.description-2: From forts and churches to temples and colorful Portuguese lanes, the trip balances exploration with relaxation.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Goa – Leisure Day
itinerary.para: Upon arrival at Goa Airport, our representative will warmly welcome you and provide a private transfer to your hotel. After check-in, the day is yours to relax or explore nearby beaches and local markets at your own pace. Whether you take a sunset stroll along the beach or indulge in Goan cuisine, the first day sets a relaxing tone for your coastal escape.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Full-Day North Goa Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After a delicious breakfast at the hotel, get ready to explore the vibrant landscapes of North Goa. Begin with a visit to the historic Fort Aguada, a Portuguese-era fortress offering panoramic sea views. From there, head to Sinquerim Beach and the lively Candolim Beach, known for water sports and peaceful ambiance. Visit the beautiful St. Alex Church and continue to the ever-popular Baga Beach, buzzing with shacks and music. The day also covers Chapora Fort, famous for its sunset views and Bollywood fame, followed by a visit to Vagator and Anjuna Beach—perfect for unwinding amidst cliffs, markets, and waves.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Full-Day South Goa Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Post breakfast, embark on a serene journey through South Goa’s cultural heart. The tour begins at Miramar Beach, a peaceful spot near the capital city Panaji. Visit the iconic Dona Paula viewpoint, where the Mandovi and Zuari rivers meet the sea. Explore Goa’s spiritual side with a visit to the Basilica of Bom Jesus, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, followed by the Mangeshi and Shanta Durga Temples, which are known for their unique Goan architecture. Conclude the tour with a walk through Fontainhas, the Latin Quarter of Panaji, where Portuguese-style colorful homes and narrow lanes take you back in time.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Departure from Goa
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from the hotel. A private transfer will take you to Goa Airport for your return journey, filled with sun-soaked memories and the relaxed spirit of the coast.

title: Manali Getaway
description: A 3-night Manali escape blending snow thrills, spirituality, and leisure at a budget-friendly price.
subtitle: 3 Nights 4 Days | Mountains, Spirituality & Snow Thrills
para: Stay in a comfortable 3-star hotel, enjoy delicious meals, and experience Solang Valley, Manikaran Sahib, Kasol Market, and Mall Road with private sightseeing.

overview.subtitle: Snow, Serenity & Himalayan Charm
overview.description-1: This 3N/4D Manali getaway is perfect for couples, families, and friends seeking a refreshing holiday in the Himalayas.
overview.description-2: From Solang Valley’s snow adventures to the spiritual calm of Manikaran Sahib, this trip covers adventure, culture, and leisure.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Manali + Half Day Local Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Arrive at Manali Volvo Bus Stand in the morning, where our representative will assist you to your hotel. After check-in and some rest, head out for a half-day local sightseeing tour. Visit Hadimba Temple, Van Vihar, and Mall Road, where you can shop and enjoy local delicacies. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Solang Valley Excursion
itinerary.para: After breakfast, set out for a thrilling day at Solang Valley, known for its stunning snow-capped mountains and adventure sports. You can try paragliding, snow biking, ropeway rides, or just soak in the scenic beauty (activities at own cost). Return to your hotel by evening. Dinner and overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Kullu, Manikaran Sahib & Kasol Exploration
itinerary.para: Post breakfast, head on a serene full-day excursion to Kullu Valley and the spiritual town of Manikaran Sahib, famous for its natural hot springs and revered Gurudwara. On the way back, stroll through the Kasol Market, known as the ‘Mini Israel of India’, and enjoy the tranquil vibes. Return to Manali for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Departure from Manali
itinerary.para: Enjoy your final breakfast in the mountains. After check-out, the day is free to explore nearby cafes or relax. In the evening, you’ll be transferred to the Manali Volvo Bus Stand to board your overnight bus back to Delhi/Chandigarh.

inclusions: 03 Nights’ accommodation in a 3★ hotel in Manali
Kullu + Manikaran Sahib + Kasol Tour (Private Cab)

title: Himachal Escape: Manali & Kasol Bliss
description: A 4-night blend of adventure and tranquility in Manali & Kasol, with riverside camping and mountain views.
subtitle: 4 Nights 5 Days | Adventure, Riverside Camping & Himalayan Bliss
para: Stay in Manali & Kasol, explore Solang Valley, visit Manikaran Sahib, and relax by the Parvati River with trekking options around Kasol.

overview.subtitle: Mountains, Rivers & Spiritual Calm
overview.description-1: A perfect Himachal escape combining Manali’s snowy adventures with Kasol’s riverside calm.
overview.description-2: Explore Solang Valley, Manikaran Sahib, and Kasol’s hippie vibe with treks, cafes, and riverside camping.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Manali + Local Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Arrive at Manali Volvo Bus Stand and get a private transfer to your hotel. After check-in and some rest, head out for a short local sightseeing tour. Visit Hadimba Temple, Van Vihar, and enjoy a relaxing walk on Mall Road. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Solang Valley Excursion
itinerary.para: After breakfast, depart for a day trip to the breathtaking Solang Valley. Enjoy optional adventure activities like paragliding, snow biking, or gondola rides (at your own expense). Return to Manali in the evening. Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Manali to Kasol + Manikaran Sahib Visit
itinerary.para: After breakfast and check-out, transfer to Kasol – the scenic hippie town in Parvati Valley (approx. 2.5 hrs). En route, visit the revered Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara, famous for its hot springs. Check-in to your riverside campsite in Kasol and enjoy the evening by the river under the stars. Dinner and overnight stay at the camp.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Leisure Day in Kasol
itinerary.para: Enjoy a peaceful breakfast by the riverside. The day is free for you to explore Kasol’s cafes, indulge in shopping, or go on a short trek to nearby villages like Chalal or Tosh. Dinner and overnight at the campsite.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Departure from Kasol

title: Spiti Valley Bike Trip
description: An epic 9-day bike expedition through Spiti Valley’s high-altitude terrains, monasteries, villages, and Chandratal Lake.
subtitle: 8 Nights 9 Days | Thrill, Culture & Himalayan Adventure
para: Ride through Kullu, Sarahan, Sangla, Kaza, Kunzum Pass, and Chandratal on a Royal Enfield Himalayan. Includes bike, stay, meals, backup, and guides.

overview.subtitle: Ride the Himalayas – Spiti Valley Expedition
overview.description-1: This 8N/9D bike trip is for wanderers craving thrill, remote beauty, and Himalayan culture.
overview.description-2: Cover Kullu, Sarahan, Sangla, Kaza, Chandratal, and Manali with monasteries, high passes, and rugged trails.

itinerary.label: Day 0
itinerary.title: Delhi to Kullu (Overnight Volvo)
itinerary.para: Depart from Delhi in the evening aboard a semi-sleeper Volvo bus. Travel overnight to Kullu, nestled in the lap of the Himalayas. Catch your first glimpse of winding roads, pine forests, and fresh mountain air.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Kullu – Leisure Day
itinerary.para: Reach Kullu by morning and check into your stay. The day is free to rest or explore local attractions like the Beas riverside, temples, or markets. In the evening, meet your fellow bikers and crew. Get a briefing on the route, check your bikes, and prepare for the journey ahead.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Kullu to Sarahan (165 km)
itinerary.para: Begin your ride towards Sarahan, a small village surrounded by apple orchards and deodar forests. En route, pass scenic mountain roads and riverside views. Upon arrival, visit the famed Bhimakali Temple, one of the 51 Shakti Peethas with striking Himalayan architecture. Overnight stay in a homely atmosphere amidst nature.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Sarahan to Sangla (90 km)
itinerary.para: Ride into the beautiful Baspa Valley and reach Sangla, known for its picture-perfect beauty. Surrounded by pine trees and flanked by snow-capped peaks, Sangla offers serenity and adventure. Visit Rakcham village, take short hikes, or enjoy riverside relaxation. A night in Sangla introduces you to Kinnaur’s peaceful rhythm.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Sangla to Kaza (230 km)
itinerary.para: An epic ride awaits as you enter the barren yet breathtaking Spiti Valley. Cross remote villages like Nako, and visit the thousand-year-old Tabo Monastery. The landscape dramatically shifts from green to arid brown cliffs and otherworldly formations. Reach Kaza, your gateway to Spiti, and unwind.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Kaza Local Sightseeing
itinerary.para: A full day of exploration in and around Kaza. Visit the iconic Key Monastery, perched dramatically on a cliff. Ride to Komic (the highest motorable village), Hikkim (home to the world's highest post office), and Langza (known for fossils and its giant Buddha statue). Soak in Spiti’s culture and calm.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Kaza to Chandratal via Kunzum Pass
itinerary.para: After breakfast, ride through the high-altitude Kunzum Pass (15,000 ft) towards Chandratal Lake. The road is rugged but the reward is beyond imagination. Camp beside the crescent-shaped lake under the clearest skies. Perfect spot for stargazing and reflecting on your Himalayan journey.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Chandratal to Manali
itinerary.para: Ride towards Manali, crossing challenging terrains, water crossings, and villages like Batal, Chatru, and Gramphoo. The ride is both thrilling and rewarding. Reach Manali by evening and enjoy your last dinner together. Share stories, laughter, and memories of an unforgettable expedition.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Volvo to Delhi
itinerary.para: Explore a bit of Old Manali during the day. Shop for souvenirs, café hop, or simply relax by the river. In the afternoon, board your return Volvo bus to Delhi.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi
itinerary.para: Arrive in Delhi early morning, carrying with you a heart full of Spiti and stories that will last a lifetime.

exclusions: Spare bike parts or damage costs
important-notes: Riders must handle high passes & off-roads

title: Murudeshwar & Jog Falls
description: Embark on a serene coastal journey where spirituality meets nature.
subtitle: 3 Nights 4 Days | Spirituality & Nature Escape
para: This package offers a perfect blend of divine experiences and breathtaking landscapes with Murudeshwar Temple, Shiva Statue, beaches, and Jog Falls.

overview.subtitle: Spirituality Meets Nature
overview.description-1: Witness Murudeshwar’s iconic temple and Shiva statue by the Arabian Sea.
overview.description-2: Experience the beauty of Jog Falls, one of India’s highest waterfalls.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival at Murudeshwar
itinerary.para: Arrive at Murudeshwar by train/road and check in to your hotel. Later, visit the famous Murudeshwar Temple dedicated to Lord Shiva and admire the 123 ft tall Shiva statue overlooking the Arabian Sea. Spend your evening relaxing at Murudeshwar Beach. Overnight stay in Murudeshwar.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Explore Murudeshwar & Nearby Attractions
itinerary.para: After breakfast, explore Murudeshwar Fort and enjoy some free time at the beach. Adventure lovers can try optional activities like scuba diving at Netrani Island or water sports (additional cost). Return to the hotel by evening and relax. Overnight stay in Murudeshwar.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Excursion to Jog Falls
itinerary.para: After breakfast, take a scenic drive to Jog Falls, one of the tallest and most majestic waterfalls in India, formed by the Sharavathi River. Witness the four stunning cascades – Raja, Rani, Rocket, and Roarer – creating a mesmerizing sight. After spending time amidst nature, return to Murudeshwar. Overnight stay in Murudeshwar.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from the hotel. You will be dropped at Murudeshwar railway station/bus stand for your return journey, carrying wonderful memories of Murudeshwar and Jog Falls.

inclusions: Visit to Murudeshwar Temple, Beach & Shiva Statue
important-notes: Customization with Gokarna, Udupi, or Coorg possible

title: Bandipur National Park
description: Step into the wild heart of Karnataka with a short escape to Bandipur National Park, one of India’s most famous tiger reserves.
subtitle: 2 Nights 3 Days | Tiger Reserve & Jungle Safari
para: Enjoy thrilling jeep safaris, nature walks, and a serene stay in the wild at Bandipur National Park.

overview.subtitle: Into the Wild – Bandipur
overview.description-1: Encounter elephants, tigers, leopards, and birds in their natural habitat.
overview.description-2: Relax in a jungle resort surrounded by nature and tranquility.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival at Bandipur
itinerary.para: Arrive at Bandipur by road and check in to your jungle resort. After freshening up, spend the day at leisure enjoying the resort’s natural surroundings. In the evening, relax amidst the wilderness with a peaceful nature walk. Overnight stay in Bandipur.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Jungle Safari Adventure
itinerary.para: Early in the morning, gear up for an exciting jeep safari into Bandipur National Park. Witness the untouched beauty of the forest and keep your eyes open for sightings of elephants, spotted deer, wild boars, peacocks, and if lucky, the elusive tiger or leopard. Return to the resort for breakfast. Spend the afternoon at leisure or opt for another safari (at additional cost). Evening free to enjoy campfire or relax at the resort. Overnight stay in Bandipur.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from your resort and depart with wonderful memories of your close encounters with nature and wildlife.

inclusions: 02 Nights accommodation in a jungle resort
important-notes: Safari timings subject to forest department

title: Coorg & Ooty Tour
description: This package combines the beauty of Coorg and Ooty, offering plantations, waterfalls, lakes, gardens, and misty valleys.
subtitle: 5 Nights 6 Days | Coffee Plantations & Hill Escapes
para: Discover the Scotland of India – Coorg and the Queen of Hills – Ooty with scenic drives, waterfalls, gardens, and tea estates.

overview.subtitle: Coorg & Ooty Highlights
overview.description-1: Explore Coorg’s temples, waterfalls, and coffee plantations.
overview.description-2: Enjoy Ooty’s gardens, lakes, and tea estates.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Coorg
itinerary.para: Arrive at Mangalore / Bangalore Airport or Railway Station and transfer to Coorg. En route, enjoy scenic views of lush green hills and winding roads. On arrival, check in at your hotel and relax. Evening free for leisure or a short stroll in nearby coffee plantations. Overnight stay in Coorg.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Coorg Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day sightseeing tour of Coorg. Visit Talacauvery – the origin of River Kaveri, Bhagamandala Temple, and the breathtaking Abbey Falls. Later, explore the famous Raja’s Seat offering panoramic views of misty valleys. Evening visit to Omkareshwara Temple, a blend of Gothic and Islamic styles. Overnight stay in Coorg.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Coorg Exploration
itinerary.para: Post breakfast, head out to explore more gems of Coorg. Visit the Dubare Elephant Camp where you can watch and interact with elephants. Later, proceed to Namdroling Monastery (Golden Temple) in Bylakuppe, one of the largest Tibetan settlements in India. Evening free for shopping in Coorg’s local market (spices, homemade chocolates, coffee). Overnight stay in Coorg.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Coorg to Ooty
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Ooty. Enjoy the beautiful journey through winding roads, tea plantations, and forests of the Nilgiris. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel. Evening visit to the serene Ooty Lake for a boat ride (optional). Overnight stay in Ooty.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Ooty Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, head for Ooty sightseeing. Visit the enchanting Botanical Gardens, the picturesque Rose Garden, and the iconic Doddabetta Peak, the highest point in the Nilgiris offering breathtaking views. Later, explore Tea Museum & Tea Factory to learn about tea making. Evening free to enjoy shopping at the local market. Overnight stay in Ooty.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed towards Bangalore / Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey with fond memories of Coorg and Ooty.

inclusions: 05 Nights’ accommodation in 3-star hotels (03 Coorg + 02 Ooty)

title: Coorg, Ooty, Mysore & Coonoor Tour
description: Embark on a week-long journey through Coorg, Mysore, Ooty & Coonoor with plantations, palaces, waterfalls, gardens, and toy train rides.
subtitle: 6 Nights 7 Days | Heritage, Hills & Coffee Estates
para: This journey blends nature, adventure, spirituality, and heritage across Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.

overview.subtitle: Ultimate Karnataka & Tamil Nadu Holiday
overview.description-1: From coffee plantations in Coorg to royal palaces in Mysore.
overview.description-2: From Ooty’s tea estates to Coonoor’s valleys, a complete hill escape.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Mysore – Transfer to Coorg
itinerary.para: Arrive at Bangalore or Mysore Airport/Railway Station. Drive to Coorg, known as the Scotland of India. En route, enjoy scenic landscapes and lush greenery. On arrival, check in at your hotel and relax. Evening free for leisure or exploring nearby coffee estates. Overnight stay in Coorg.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Coorg Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, explore Coorg’s natural and cultural highlights. Visit Abbey Falls, surrounded by coffee plantations, and the historic Omkareshwara Temple. Later, head to Raja’s Seat for mesmerizing sunset views. Evening free for shopping (coffee, spices & homemade chocolates). Overnight stay in Coorg.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Coorg Exploration
itinerary.para: Post breakfast, visit Dubare Elephant Camp where you can observe and interact with elephants. Continue to Namdroling Monastery (Golden Temple) at Bylakuppe, the largest Tibetan settlement in South India. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay in Coorg.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Coorg to Ooty via Mysore
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and proceed to Mysore. Visit the magnificent Mysore Palace, one of India’s grandest palaces, and the Chamundi Hills with the famous Chamundeshwari Temple. Stroll at Brindavan Gardens, known for its musical fountain show. Later, continue your journey to Ooty. Overnight stay in Ooty.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Ooty Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Enjoy breakfast and explore Ooty, the Queen of Hills. Visit the sprawling Botanical Garden, the colorful Rose Garden, and the panoramic Doddabetta Peak. Later, enjoy boating at Ooty Lake and visit the Tea Factory & Tea Museum. Overnight stay in Ooty.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Coonoor Excursion
itinerary.para: After breakfast, take a short drive to Coonoor. Explore Sim’s Park, Dolphin’s Nose Viewpoint, and Lamb’s Rock, offering stunning views of tea estates and valleys. Optionally, enjoy a ride on the Nilgiri Mountain Toy Train (UNESCO heritage). Return to Ooty for overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and proceed to Bangalore / Mysore / Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey, taking back unforgettable memories of Karnataka & Tamil Nadu’s hill escapes.

inclusions: 06 Nights’ accommodation in 3-star hotels (02 Coorg + 01 Mysore + 02 Ooty + 01 Coonoor)
important-notes: Best time to visit: October to May

overview.subtitle: Scenic Beauty & Cultural Encounters in Kashmir
overview.description-1: Stay 3 nights in Srinagar and 1 night on a deluxe houseboat while exploring Kashmir’s most famous valleys and gardens.
overview.description-2: From Mughal Gardens and Dal Lake to Gulmarg, Pahalgam, and Sonmarg, every day promises unforgettable sights.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar + Local Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Arrive at Srinagar Airport where our representative will receive you. Check in to your hotel and relax. In the afternoon, explore the Mughal Gardens – Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi, and enjoy the scenic Dal Lake promenade. Overnight stay and dinner at the hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Excursion to Gulmarg

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Excursion to Pahalgam

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Excursion to Sonmarg + Houseboat Stay
itinerary.para: After an early breakfast, travel to Sonmarg, the Meadow of Gold. You may take an optional pony ride to Thajiwas Glacier. Return to Srinagar by evening and check-in to your houseboat on Dal Lake. Enjoy a traditional Kashmiri dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Srinagar Airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Kashmir.

title: Enchanting Kerala Escape
description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Kerala, 'God’s Own Country', through this thoughtfully crafted 5-day journey.
subtitle: 4 Nights 5 Days | Hills, Wildlife & Backwaters
para: Wander through lush tea gardens in Munnar, witness wildlife in Thekkady, and unwind with a serene houseboat cruise in Alleppey. From misty hills to palm-lined canals, this 5-day Kerala escape is nature at its best.

overview.subtitle: Tea Hills, Spice Trails & Backwaters – The Essence of Kerala
overview.description-1: This Kerala itinerary offers a peaceful blend of hill stations, spice gardens, wildlife, and backwaters for a perfect holiday.
overview.description-2: Stay in handpicked hotels and a deluxe houseboat while enjoying cultural performances, local flavors, and scenic drives.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi – Transfer to Munnar via Cochin Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Upon arrival at Kochi Airport or Railway Station, our representative will greet you and begin your journey to Munnar (approx. 4–5 hours). En route, enjoy sightseeing in Cochin including a visit to Marine Drive, Dutch Palace, Jewish Synagogue (closed on Fridays), and the iconic Chinese Fishing Nets. As you ascend into the hills, you’ll be treated to scenic views of waterfalls, spice plantations, and lush greenery. Arrive in Munnar by evening and check into your hotel. Relax and enjoy the cool mountain air. Overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Munnar Local Sightseeing – Tea, Hills & Nature
itinerary.para: After breakfast, set off for a full-day exploration of Munnar’s natural gems. Visit the famous Eravikulam National Park (home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr, closed from Feb–April), followed by the Tea Museum to witness tea processing and taste fresh brews. Continue to Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and Kundala Lake where you can enjoy optional pedal boating. Later, stroll through tea gardens and local markets. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady – Wild Beauty & Spice Trails
itinerary.para: Check out after breakfast and drive towards Thekkady (approx. 3.5 hrs). En route, enjoy a scenic drive through spice plantations and forests. On arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Later, visit the Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary (optional boat ride on Periyar Lake – at own cost) and explore spice gardens. Enjoy a Kathakali dance show or Kalari martial arts performance in the evening (optional). Overnight stay in Thekkady.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey – Houseboat Backwater Cruise
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and drive to Alleppey (approx. 4 hrs), known for its tranquil backwaters and lush paddy fields. On arrival, board your private deluxe houseboat. Cruise through scenic canals, lakes, and villages, watching life unfold on the banks. Enjoy a freshly prepared Kerala-style lunch and dinner onboard as you drift through the backwaters. This unique overnight stay offers peace and a taste of Kerala’s rustic charm.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Departure from Alleppey – Drop at Kochi
itinerary.para: Enjoy breakfast on the houseboat before check-out. You will be transferred back to Kochi Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey, carrying back serene memories of your Kerala holiday.

inclusions: Private AC Cab for entire tour
important-notes: Houseboat AC works 9 PM to 6 AM

title: Charming Kerala Retreat
description: Explore the best of Kerala in 6 days – from Cochin’s heritage to Munnar’s hills, Thekkady’s spice plantations, and Alleppey’s backwaters.
subtitle: 5 Nights 6 Days | Hills, Wildlife & Backwaters
para: From Cochin’s coastal charm to the rolling hills of Munnar, the spice-scented air of Thekkady, and the calm backwaters of Alleppey, this package covers it all.

overview.subtitle: Culture, Nature & Backwaters – Kerala in 6 Days
overview.description-1: Stay in Cochin, Munnar, Thekkady, and Alleppey to cover Kerala’s most popular highlights.
overview.description-2: Private transfers, cultural shows, and a deluxe houseboat make this trip memorable.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival at Kochi – City Tour
itinerary.para: Upon arrival at Kochi Airport or Railway Station, you will be welcomed by our representative and transferred to your hotel. After check-in and some rest, explore the historic city of Cochin. Visit famous sites like Fort Kochi, the Dutch Palace, Jewish Synagogue, St. Francis Church, and the traditional Chinese Fishing Nets. Take a sunset walk along the Marine Drive or enjoy the art cafés of Fort Kochi. Return to your hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Kochi to Munnar – Scenic Drive
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and drive to the hill station of Munnar (approx. 4–5 hrs). En route, stop at Cheeyappara and Valara Waterfalls and admire the lush green tea estates along the winding roads. On reaching Munnar, check in to your hotel and spend the evening at leisure, enjoying the cool breeze and serene surroundings. Dinner and overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Full-Day Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast and then head out to explore Munnar’s most famous attractions. Visit the Eravikulam National Park (home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr), Tea Museum, and enjoy panoramic views at Mattupetty Dam and Echo Point. Later, explore Kundala Lake, where boating is available (optional), and walk through the aromatic spice and tea plantations. Return to your hotel in the evening. Dinner and overnight in Munnar.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady – Spice & Wildlife
itinerary.para: After breakfast, drive to Thekkady (approx. 3.5 hours) through beautiful spice gardens and forested hills. On arrival, check in to your hotel. Later, visit the Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary (boat safari optional) and a local spice plantation. Thekkady is also known for cultural shows — you can choose to watch a live Kathakali dance or Kalaripayattu martial art performance (optional). Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey – Houseboat Stay
itinerary.para: Post breakfast, proceed to Alleppey (approx. 4 hours). Check into your private deluxe houseboat by noon. Cruise through the scenic backwaters, passing by lush green paddy fields, small villages, and coconut groves. Enjoy freshly prepared traditional Kerala cuisine onboard. Soak in the peaceful ambiance as the boat anchors by evening. Dinner and overnight on the houseboat.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Departure from Alleppey – Drop at Kochi
itinerary.para: After breakfast on the houseboat, check out and proceed to Kochi Airport or Railway Station for your departure, with unforgettable memories of your Kerala journey.

important-notes: Weather & road conditions may affect sightseeing

title: Magical Kerala Escape
description: Embark on a soul-soothing 7-day Kerala journey covering Munnar, Thekkady, Alleppey Houseboat, and Kovalam’s beaches.
subtitle: 6 Nights 7 Days | Hills, Backwaters & Beaches
para: From misty tea hills of Munnar to wildlife in Thekkady, houseboat cruise in Alleppey, and sun-kissed beaches of Kovalam — this trip is Kerala at its finest.

overview.subtitle: Kerala Hills, Backwaters & Beaches – A Complete Experience
overview.description-1: Balanced itinerary covering hill stations, wildlife, backwaters, and beaches with premium stays.
overview.description-2: Cultural tours, Ayurvedic options, and city sightseeing included for a wholesome experience.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival at Kochi – Transfer to Munnar with Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Arrive at Kochi Airport or Railway Station where our representative will warmly greet you. Begin your scenic drive to Munnar (approx. 4–5 hours). En route, enjoy sightseeing in Cochin with stops at the Dutch Palace, Jewish Synagogue, St. Francis Church, and the iconic Chinese Fishing Nets. Continue your journey through winding roads flanked by waterfalls, tea gardens, and spice plantations. Check-in at your hotel in Munnar for an overnight stay and dinner.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Munnar Local Sightseeing – Nature’s Canvas
itinerary.para: After a delightful breakfast, explore the best of Munnar. Begin with a visit to Eravikulam National Park (closed from Feb–April), followed by a stop at the Tea Museum to learn about tea cultivation. Later, see the stunning views from Mattupetty Dam and Echo Point, and enjoy boating at Kundala Lake. End your day with a leisurely walk through tea gardens and local markets before returning to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady – Spice Hills & Wildlife
itinerary.para: Post breakfast, check out and head towards Thekkady (approx. 3.5 hours), passing through scenic spice plantations and lush forests. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and relax. Visit the Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary (optional boat ride at own cost), followed by a tour of spice gardens. In the evening, enjoy optional cultural performances like Kathakali or Kalaripayattu (martial arts). Dinner and overnight stay in Thekkady.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey – Houseboat Cruise
itinerary.para: After breakfast, drive to Alleppey (approx. 4 hours) where your private deluxe houseboat awaits. Cruise through the charming backwaters, watching paddy fields, coconut groves, and daily life unfold on the riverbanks. Enjoy freshly prepared Kerala cuisine onboard. Spend a peaceful evening as your houseboat anchors in a quiet canal. Dinner and overnight stay in the houseboat.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Alleppey to Kovalam – Coastal Bliss
itinerary.para: After breakfast, disembark from the houseboat and proceed to Kovalam (approx. 4.5–5 hours), Kerala’s popular beach retreat. On arrival, check into your beachside resort and unwind. In the evening, take a leisurely stroll along Lighthouse Beach, Samudra Beach or Hawa Beach and enjoy the sunset views. Dinner and overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Kovalam & Trivandrum Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Enjoy breakfast and set out for a half-day sightseeing tour of Trivandrum. Visit Padmanabhaswamy Temple (famous for its intricate architecture), Napier Museum, and the Zoological Park. Return to Kovalam for the rest of the day at leisure — relax on the beach, indulge in an Ayurvedic massage, or shop at local markets. Dinner and overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Departure from Kovalam – Drop at Trivandrum
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Trivandrum International Airport for your return journey, carrying unforgettable memories of Kerala’s hilltops, backwaters, and beaches.

important-notes: Sightseeing subject to weather & road conditions

title: Jaipur City Tour
description: Discover the royal charm of Rajasthan with forts, palaces, and vibrant markets in just 3 days.
subtitle: 2 Nights 3 Days | Royal Charm of the Pink City
para: Explore Jaipur’s regal history through forts, palaces, observatories, and colorful markets. A short escape blending culture, heritage, and traditions.

overview.subtitle: History, Culture & Heritage – The Jaipur Experience
overview.description-1: This Jaipur package gives you a perfect mix of sightseeing, local bazaars, and cultural exploration of the Pink City.
overview.description-2: From Amber Fort to Hawa Mahal and Jantar Mantar, relive the grandeur of Rajputana.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur & Local Sightseeing
itinerary.para: On arrival at Jaipur Airport/Railway Station, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, begin your exploration with a visit to the City Palace, a royal residence showcasing Rajasthani and Mughal architecture. Continue to Jantar Mantar, a UNESCO World Heritage site and one of the world’s largest astronomical observatories. In the evening, admire the illuminated Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds) and take a stroll through the colorful local markets for handicrafts and traditional Rajasthani attire. Overnight stay at Jaipur.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Jaipur Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day sightseeing tour. Start with the majestic Amber Fort, where you can enjoy an elephant ride (optional) and witness the grandeur of Rajputana architecture. On the way back, stop at the beautiful Jal Mahal (Water Palace) for photographs. Later, visit the Albert Hall Museum, showcasing Jaipur’s history and art. Evening free to explore the vibrant bazaars or experience an optional Chokhi Dhani Village tour for cultural performances and authentic Rajasthani dinner (at extra cost). Overnight stay at Jaipur.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Departure from Jaipur
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to Jaipur Airport/Railway Station for your onward journey with wonderful memories of the Pink City.

inclusions: Pickup & drop from Jaipur Airport / Railway Station
All sightseeing & transfers by private AC vehicle
Driver allowance, tolls, parking & fuel charges
exclusions: Entry fees, guide charges, and elephant ride
important-notes: Prices may vary during festivals/peak season
Early check-in/late check-out as per hotel policy

title: Jaipur & Jodhpur Tour
description: Blend the royal charm of Jaipur with the heritage of Jodhpur in 5 days of exploration.
subtitle: 4 Nights 5 Days | Pink City & Blue City Escape
para: Explore Jaipur’s forts and palaces along with Jodhpur’s Mehrangarh Fort, Umaid Bhawan, and blue city charm.

overview.subtitle: Pink City Meets Blue City – Rajasthan’s Regal Blend
overview.description-1: This package gives you the combined experience of Jaipur and Jodhpur with their forts, palaces, and bazaars.
overview.description-2: From Amber Fort to Mehrangarh Fort, the tour showcases Rajasthan’s heritage and culture.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur & Local Exploration
itinerary.para: Upon arrival at Jaipur Airport/Railway Station, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, begin your sightseeing with a visit to the City Palace, a stunning blend of Rajasthani and Mughal design, and Jantar Mantar, the UNESCO World Heritage astronomical observatory. Later, capture the beauty of the Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds) and take a leisurely stroll through the local bazaars. Overnight stay at Jaipur.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Jaipur Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day city tour. Explore the magnificent Amber Fort, where the grandeur of Rajputana architecture comes alive. En route, stop at the picturesque Jal Mahal (Water Palace). Later, visit the Albert Hall Museum, and in the evening, you may opt for a cultural Rajasthani experience at Chokhi Dhani Village (optional, extra cost). Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Jaipur – Jodhpur (By Train – Own Cost)
itinerary.para: Check out after breakfast and proceed to Jaipur Railway Station for your train to Jodhpur (train ticket at own cost). On arrival, transfer to your hotel and relax. Evening free at leisure or explore the local markets of Jodhpur for handicrafts, spices, and textiles. Overnight stay at Jodhpur.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Jodhpur Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, begin your Jodhpur sightseeing with the imposing Mehrangarh Fort, one of the largest forts in India with spectacular views of the blue city. Next, visit the elegant Umaid Bhawan Palace, still partly occupied by the royal family. Later, explore the serene Jaswant Thada, a white marble cenotaph built in memory of Maharaja Jaswant Singh II. Evening free to enjoy the vibrant streets and blue houses of the old city. Overnight stay at Jodhpur.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Departure from Jodhpur
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Jodhpur Airport/Railway Station for your onward journey with beautiful memories of Rajasthan.

inclusions: Sightseeing & transfers by private AC vehicle
Driver allowance, tolls, parking & fuel charges
exclusions: Entry fees, guide charges & optional activities
important-notes: Jaipur to Jodhpur train at own cost
Early check-in/late check-out subject to policy

title: Rajasthan Desert & Royal Tour
description: Experience Jaisalmer, Jodhpur, and Udaipur with forts, deserts, palaces, and lakes in 7 days.
subtitle: 6 Nights 7 Days | Desert, Blue City & Lake City
para: Discover Rajasthan’s golden sands, blue streets, and lakeside palaces with Jaisalmer, Jodhpur, and Udaipur combined.

overview.subtitle: Desert Charm, Royal Heritage & Lake Serenity
overview.description-1: This Rajasthan package blends Jaisalmer’s desert, Jodhpur’s blue lanes, and Udaipur’s lakeside romance.
overview.description-2: From camel rides at Sam Sand Dunes to Mehrangarh Fort and City Palace Udaipur, it’s a complete Rajasthan circuit.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaisalmer
itinerary.para: Arrive at Jaisalmer Railway Station/Airport, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, visit Patwon Ki Haveli, Salim Singh Ki Haveli, and the Jaisalmer Fort (Sonar Quila), one of the only “living forts” in India. Evening free for shopping in the local bazaars. Overnight stay at Jaisalmer.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Jaisalmer – Sam Sand Dunes Experience
itinerary.para: After breakfast, explore the Gadisar Lake and Bada Bagh. Later in the afternoon, head to the Sam Sand Dunes for a desert adventure. Enjoy a camel ride, mesmerizing sunset views, followed by Rajasthani cultural performances and dinner at a desert camp. Overnight stay in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Jaisalmer to Jodhpur (By Train – Own Cost)
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and board your train to Jodhpur (train cost not included). Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and relax. Evening free to explore the bustling markets of Jodhpur famous for handicrafts, spices, and antiques. Overnight stay at Jodhpur.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Jodhpur Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, proceed for full-day sightseeing. Visit the imposing Mehrangarh Fort with its museum and spectacular views of the blue city. Next, explore the elegant Umaid Bhawan Palace and the peaceful Jaswant Thada. Evening free to enjoy the old blue lanes and local cuisine. Overnight stay at Jodhpur.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Jodhpur – Udaipur (By Train – Own Cost)
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and proceed to Udaipur by train (own cost). On arrival, transfer to hotel and relax. In the evening, enjoy a boat ride at Lake Pichola (optional, at extra cost) and witness the beautiful City Palace complex by sunset. Overnight stay at Udaipur.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Udaipur Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, enjoy full-day sightseeing in the “City of Lakes.” Visit the grand City Palace, Saheliyon Ki Bari (Garden of Maidens), Jagdish Temple, and Vintage Car Museum. Evening free for shopping at Hathi Pol Bazaar. Overnight stay at Udaipur.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Departure from Udaipur
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Udaipur Airport/Railway Station for your onward journey with wonderful memories of Rajasthan.

inclusions: 02 Nights stay in Jaisalmer (3-star hotel & 1 night desert camp)
Dinner & cultural program at Jaisalmer camp
Private AC car for sightseeing & transfers
Driver allowance, tolls, parking & fuel charges
exclusions: Entry fees, guide charges & optional activities
important-notes: Early check-in/late check-out subject to policy

title: Ranthambore Wildlife Tour
description: Spot Royal Bengal Tigers and explore Ranthambore’s wilderness with safaris and local sightseeing in 3 days.
subtitle: 2 Nights 3 Days | Tiger Safari & Nature Escape
para: A short wildlife getaway with jeep safari inside Ranthambore National Park and local attractions like forts and temples.

overview.subtitle: Thrilling Safaris & Historic Attractions
overview.description-1: This Ranthambore package offers tiger safaris and cultural sightseeing around the national park.
overview.description-2: From jungle safaris to Ranthambore Fort and Padam Talab Lake, it’s a nature and history blend.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival at Sawai Madhopur – Transfer to Ranthambore
itinerary.para: Arrive at Sawai Madhopur Railway Station, where our representative will meet you and transfer you to the hotel/resort in Ranthambore. After check-in, relax and later visit nearby attractions such as Ranthambore Fort (a UNESCO World Heritage Site), Trinetra Ganesh Temple, and Padam Talab Lake. Evening free for leisure. Overnight stay at Ranthambore.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Jungle Safari in Ranthambore National Park
itinerary.para: Wake up early for a thrilling jeep safari inside Ranthambore National Park – one of the best tiger reserves in India. Spot not just tigers but also leopards, sloth bears, marsh crocodiles, and a wide variety of birds. Return to hotel for breakfast. Day at leisure or optional second safari (at extra cost). Overnight stay in Ranthambore.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Departure from Ranthambore
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer back to Sawai Madhopur Railway Station for your onward journey, carrying unforgettable wildlife memories.

inclusions: One Jeep Safari inside Ranthambore National Park
Pickup & drop from Sawai Madhopur Railway Station
Private AC vehicle for sightseeing & transfers
Driver allowance, tolls, parking & fuel charges
exclusions: Additional safari rides other than included
important-notes: Safari zones allotted by forest department rules
Early check-in/late check-out subject to hotel policy

title: Gangtok Delight Tour
description: Embark on a magical journey to Gangtok – the heart of Sikkim.
subtitle: 4 Nights 5 Days | Adventure, Culture & Natural Beauty
para: This Gangtok package covers Nathu La Pass, Tsomgo Lake, Baba Mandir, Namchi, and key attractions of Gangtok with a balance of sightseeing, culture, and leisure.

overview.subtitle: A Perfect Blend of Culture, Adventure & Himalayan Charm
overview.description-1: This 5-day Gangtok package is a complete Himalayan experience with excursions, monasteries, and scenic beauty.
overview.description-2: Explore Nathu La, Tsomgo Lake, Baba Mandir, Namchi, and Gangtok’s heritage in this balanced itinerary.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Gangtok
itinerary.para: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport (IXB) or NJP Railway Station. Meet our representative and proceed towards Gangtok, a picturesque hill town. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and relax. The evening is free to stroll around MG Marg, the main street of Gangtok, dotted with cafes and shops. Overnight stay at Gangtok.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Excursion to Nathu La Pass
itinerary.para: After breakfast, set out for an exciting excursion to Nathu La Pass (Indo-China border), Tsomgo Lake, and Baba Mandir. The glacial lake surrounded by snow-capped peaks is a breathtaking sight, while the temple dedicated to Baba Harbhajan Singh holds deep reverence. Return to Gangtok by evening. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Gangtok Local Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Post breakfast, explore Gangtok’s famous attractions – Tashi View Point, Ganesh Tok, Hanuman Tok, Bakthang Waterfalls, Do Drul Chorten Stupa, Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, Flower Exhibition Centre, and Enchey Monastery. Later, enjoy the lively markets and soak in the local vibes. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Day Excursion to Namchi
itinerary.para: Today, drive to Namchi, known for its spiritual charm and panoramic views of the snow-clad mountains. Visit the Char Dham, Samdruptse Hill with the towering statue of Guru Padmasambhava, and beautiful tea gardens. After exploring, return to Gangtok for an overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Bagdogra Airport or NJP Railway Station for your onward journey with fond memories of the Sikkim Himalayas.

inclusions: Excursions to Nathu La, Tsomgo Lake, Baba Mandir & Namchi
All hotel taxes, driver allowance, tolls, fuel charges
exclusions: Nathula Pass permit charges (as per actuals & availability)
Personal expenses (shopping, meals not mentioned, tips)
important-notes: Nathula Pass subject to weather & permit availability

title: Darjeeling & Gangtok Package
description: Twin-destination escape covering Darjeeling and Gangtok with tea gardens, monasteries, lakes, and Himalayan sunrise views.
subtitle: 4 Nights 5 Days | Twin Himalayan Escape
para: This tour combines Darjeeling’s colonial charm with Gangtok’s natural and cultural highlights, including Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir.

overview.subtitle: Colonial Charm Meets Himalayan Beauty
overview.description-1: Enjoy Darjeeling’s iconic sunrise and Gangtok’s scenic attractions in one trip.
overview.description-2: From Tiger Hill to Tsomgo Lake, this itinerary balances culture and adventure.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Darjeeling
itinerary.para: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport (IXB) or NJP Railway Station. Meet our representative and transfer to Darjeeling, the “Queen of the Hills.” Check in at your hotel and relax. Evening free to explore the local market at Mall Road. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Darjeeling Local Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Early morning, drive to Tiger Hill to witness the breathtaking sunrise over Mt. Kanchenjunga. En route back, visit Ghoom Monastery and Batasia Loop. After breakfast, proceed for sightseeing covering Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Zoological Park, Tenzing Rock, Tea Gardens, and the vibrant Japanese Temple & Peace Pagoda. Evening free at leisure. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Transfer to Gangtok
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive to Gangtok. Enroute, enjoy the mesmerizing views of the Teesta River. On arrival, check into the hotel and relax. Evening free to explore MG Marg. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
itinerary.para: After breakfast, set out for an excursion to Tsomgo Lake, a stunning glacial lake, and Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir, known for its spiritual significance. Optional visit to Nathula Pass (subject to availability & permit at extra cost). Return to Gangtok by evening and relax. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Bagdogra Airport or NJP Railway Station for your onward journey with wonderful memories of the Himalayas.

inclusions: Excursions to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
important-notes: Nathula Pass optional & subject to weather
Cost valid for limited period only

title: Gangtok – Pelling – Namchi Package
description: A 7-day journey through Gangtok, Pelling, and Namchi blending spirituality, culture, and Himalayan beauty.
subtitle: 6 Nights 7 Days | Spiritual, Scenic & Cultural Journey
para: From monasteries and lakes to Char Dham and Kanchenjunga views, this Sikkim tour is a complete Himalayan escape.

overview.subtitle: Explore Sikkim’s Heritage & Scenic Wonders
overview.description-1: Covers Gangtok, Pelling, and Namchi with monasteries, waterfalls, lakes, and cultural landmarks.
overview.description-2: Perfect mix of adventure, spirituality, and relaxation in the Himalayas.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Gangtok
itinerary.para: On arrival at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport, meet our representative and proceed to Gangtok. The scenic drive along the Teesta River sets the tone for your journey. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel and relax. Evening free at leisure. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Gangtok Local Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, enjoy a full-day sightseeing tour covering Tashi View Point, Ganesh Tok, Hanuman Tok, Enchey Monastery, Do Drul Chorten, Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, Cottage Industry & Handicraft Centre, and the vibrant MG Marg. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
itinerary.para: Today, set out for an excursion to Tsomgo Lake, a glacial lake at 12,000 ft, and the sacred Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir. Optional trip to Nathula Pass (dependant on weather & permits, additional cost). Return to Gangtok for overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Gangtok to Pelling
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and proceed to Pelling. Enjoy the scenic drive through mountains and valleys. On arrival, check in at the hotel. Evening free for leisure or exploring local markets. Overnight stay in Pelling.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Pelling Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, enjoy a sightseeing tour of Pelling covering Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdentse Ruins, Helipad Ground, Rimbi Waterfalls, Khecheopalri Lake, and the majestic Kanchenjunga Falls. Return to the hotel by evening. Overnight stay in Pelling.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Pelling to Namchi
itinerary.para: Post breakfast, drive to Namchi, famous for its cultural and spiritual sites. Visit the Char Dham Complex and Samdruptse Monastery. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay in Namchi.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and transfer to NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Sikkim.

inclusions: Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
exclusions: Nathula Pass charges (extra & subject to availability)

title: Sikkim Honeymoon Escape
description: Celebrate love amidst the breathtaking beauty of Darjeeling, Gangtok, and Namchi with tea gardens, lakes, monasteries, and Char Dham.
subtitle: 6 Nights 7 Days | Romantic Himalayan Getaway
para: A romantic escape covering Darjeeling’s charm, Gangtok’s scenic highlights, and Namchi’s spiritual landmarks, with honeymoon add-ons.

overview.subtitle: Romance in the Himalayas
overview.description-1: Darjeeling sunrise, Gangtok lakes, and Namchi’s Char Dham make this a perfect honeymoon.
overview.description-2: Includes honeymoon room décor and special experiences.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Darjeeling
itinerary.para: Pickup from Bagdogra Airport / NJP Railway Station. Drive through lush tea gardens to reach Darjeeling. Check in at the hotel and relax. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Darjeeling Local Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Early morning sunrise at Tiger Hill followed by visits to Ghoom Monastery and Batasia Loop. Post breakfast, explore Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Tenzing Rock, Tibetan Refugee Centre, and Mall Road for shopping. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Darjeeling to Gangtok
itinerary.para: After breakfast, drive to Gangtok. Evening free for a romantic walk along MG Marg. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
itinerary.para: Full-day excursion to the glacial Tsomgo Lake and sacred Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir. Option to visit Nathula Pass (extra cost, subject to permit). Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Gangtok Local Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, city tour of Gangtok covering Tashi View Point, Hanuman Tok, Ganesh Tok, Do Drul Chorten Stupa, Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, and Enchey Monastery. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Gangtok to Namchi
itinerary.para: Drive to Namchi – famous for Char Dham Complex and Samdruptse Monastery. Evening at leisure amidst scenic views. Overnight stay in Namchi.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.para: After breakfast, transfer to NJP Railway Station / Bagdogra Airport with cherished honeymoon memories.

inclusions: Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir

title: A Short Escape to Nainital
description: A refreshing 2-night getaway to Nainital, the Lake City of India, with lakes, temples, viewpoints, and Mall Road strolls.
subtitle: 2 Nights 3 Days | Lakes, Hills & Leisure
para: This short trip to Nainital covers iconic attractions like Naini Lake, Naina Devi Temple, Mall Road, Snow View Point, and excursions to Bhimtal, Sattal, and Naukuchiatal.

overview.subtitle: Lakes, Hills & Leisure – A Serene Getaway
overview.description-1: Enjoy boating, ropeway rides, temple visits, and stunning viewpoints across Nainital and nearby lakes.
overview.description-2: Perfect short escape for couples, families, or friends looking for a peaceful hill retreat.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival at Kathgodam – Transfer to Nainital & Local Sightseeing
itinerary.para: Arrive at Kathgodam Railway Station where our representative will pick you up and transfer you to your hotel in Nainital. After check-in, freshen up and head out to explore the town. Visit Naina Devi Temple, Naini Lake (enjoy a peaceful boat ride on direct payment), Mall Road, and Snow View Point (via ropeway). In the evening, you can indulge in local shopping or enjoy the lakeside ambiance. Overnight stay in Nainital.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Nainital Lake Tour & Excursions
itinerary.para: After breakfast, proceed for an exciting lake tour around Nainital. Visit Bhimtal Lake, Sattal (Seven Lakes), and Naukuchiatal, each known for their scenic beauty and calm environment. Later, explore Tiffin Top, Land’s End, and Lover’s Point for panoramic hill views. Evening free for leisure. Overnight stay in Nainital.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Departure – Nainital to Kathgodam
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive back to Kathgodam Railway Station for your onward journey with wonderful memories of the Lake City.

inclusions: 02 Nights’ accommodation in Nainital at 3★ hotel
Pickup & drop from Kathgodam Railway Station
All sightseeing & transfers by private cab
important-notes: Hotels subject to availability at the time of booking
Sightseeing order may change depending on weather and time

title: Jim Corbett - Nainital
description: A short wildlife getaway to Jim Corbett with jeep safari, DJ night, bonfire, and nature exploration in 3 days.
subtitle: 2 Nights 3 Days | Safari, Wilderness & Relaxation
para: Experience the wilderness of India’s first national park, home to tigers, elephants, and exotic birds, with safari and cozy resort stay.

overview.subtitle: Safari, Wilderness & Relaxation – A Jungle Retreat
overview.description-1: Stay in a scenic resort, enjoy bonfire & DJ night, and venture into the jungle with a private jeep safari.
overview.description-2: Perfect escape for nature lovers, families, and adventure seekers.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival at Jim Corbett
itinerary.para: Arrive at Jim Corbett and check-in to your resort amidst the wilderness. After a welcome drink, relax and soak in the natural surroundings. In the evening, enjoy recreational activities at the resort followed by DJ night and bonfire under the starry sky. Dinner and overnight stay at the resort.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Jeep Safari & Local Exploration
itinerary.para: Wake up early morning and head for an adventurous private jeep safari in Corbett National Park. Explore the dense forest, grasslands, and river belts while keeping an eye out for tigers, elephants, deer, and exotic birds. After safari, return to the resort for breakfast. Rest of the day is free to explore local attractions like Garjiya Devi Temple, Corbett Museum, or simply relax at the resort poolside. Dinner and overnight stay at the resort.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from the resort with unforgettable memories of the jungle adventure. Proceed for your onward journey.

inclusions: 02 Nights’ accommodation at 3★ resort in Jim Corbett
Daily Breakfast & Dinner at the resort
01 Private Jeep Safari in available zone
important-notes: Safari zones subject to availability at booking
ID proof mandatory for safari bookings

title: Hills & Wilderness Escape – Nainital & Jim Corbett
description: A 5-day trip combining Nainital’s serene hills and Jim Corbett’s thrilling jungle safari with private transfers.
subtitle: 4 Nights 5 Days | Lakes, Hills & Jungle Safari
para: Explore Nainital’s lakes and viewpoints along with an adventurous jeep safari in Jim Corbett, all with comfortable stays and private transfers.

overview.subtitle: Lakes, Hills & Jungle Safari – A Complete Kumaon Journey
overview.description-1: This dual-destination escape blends the serenity of Nainital’s hills with the thrill of Corbett’s wilderness.
overview.description-2: Ideal for families, friends, or couples seeking both relaxation and adventure.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival at Nainital
itinerary.para: Pick up from Kathgodam Railway Station and drive to Nainital. Check into your hotel and relax. Later, explore the Naini Lake with optional boating, visit Naina Devi Temple, stroll on The Mall Road, and soak in the lakeside charm. Overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Nainital Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, enjoy a full day of sightseeing in and around Nainital. Visit Snow View Point (cable car ride optional), Tiffin Top, Eco Cave Gardens, High Altitude Zoo, Raj Bhawan (Governor’s House) and nearby lakes like Bhimtal, Sattal, and Naukuchiatal. Evening free for shopping at Mall Road. Overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Nainital – Jim Corbett
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and drive towards Jim Corbett. Upon arrival, check into your resort. Relax and enjoy the natural surroundings. In the evening, enjoy DJ night with bonfire followed by dinner. Overnight stay at resort.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Jeep Safari & Corbett Exploration
itinerary.para: Early morning, head out for a private jeep safari in one of the available zones of Jim Corbett National Park. Experience the thrill of spotting tigers, elephants, deer, and exotic birds amidst the dense forest. After breakfast, relax at the resort or visit local attractions like Garjiya Devi Temple and Corbett Museum. Dinner and overnight stay at resort.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and transfer back to Kathgodam Railway Station or your onward destination with unforgettable memories of the hills and the jungle.

inclusions: 02 Nights stay in Nainital at 3★ hotel
02 Nights stay in Jim Corbett at 3★ resort
Daily Breakfast & Dinner in Jim Corbett
01 DJ Night with Bonfire at Corbett
01 Private Jeep Safari in Jim Corbett
All transfers & sightseeing by private car
Pick up & drop from Kathgodam Railway Station
important-notes: ID proof mandatory for safari booking

title: Hills & Spiritual Escape – Mussoorie & Rishikesh
description: A 5-day journey covering Mussoorie’s scenic charm and Rishikesh’s adventure & spirituality, with Dehradun & Haridwar visits.
subtitle: 4 Nights 5 Days | Hills, Rafting & Spiritual Vibes
para: Experience Mussoorie’s natural beauty and Rishikesh’s rafting thrills and spiritual bliss, along with Haridwar excursion.

overview.subtitle: Hills, Rafting & Spiritual Vibes – A Himalayan Journey
overview.description-1: Blend sightseeing, adventure, and spirituality with visits to Mussoorie, Rishikesh, Haridwar, and Dehradun.
overview.description-2: Perfect for travelers seeking nature, thrill, and divine experiences in one trip.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival Dehradun – Mussoorie
itinerary.para: Arrive at Dehradun Railway Station/Airport, meet our representative and proceed for sightseeing. Visit Robber’s Cave, Sahastradhara (known for its healing sulphur springs), and Tapkeshwar Temple. Later, transfer to Mussoorie. After check-in, spend the evening exploring Mall Road. Overnight stay at Mussoorie.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Mussoorie Local Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, explore the gems of Mussoorie. Visit Kempty Falls – a beautiful cascading waterfall, Gun Hill for panoramic Himalayan views, Camel’s Back Road, Company Garden and the highest viewpoint Lal Tibba. Evening free for leisure/shopping. Overnight stay in Mussoorie.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Mussoorie – Rishikesh
itinerary.para: Post breakfast, drive to Rishikesh. On arrival, check in at your hotel/camp near the Ganges. In the afternoon, enjoy a thrilling white-water rafting session with professional guides, including cliff jumping & body surfing. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay in Rishikesh.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Rishikesh Sightseeing
itinerary.para: After breakfast, explore Lakshman Jhula, Ram Jhula, Parmarth Niketan Ashram, Beatles Ashram and enjoy the serene vibes of the holy town. In the evening, attend the divine Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat. Overnight stay in Rishikesh.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Rishikesh – Haridwar Excursion – Departure
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Haridwar. Visit Har Ki Pauri, Mansa Devi Temple and other sacred ghats. Later, drop at Haridwar Railway Station for onward journey with cherished memories.

inclusions: 02 Nights stay in Mussoorie at 3★ hotel
02 Nights stay in Rishikesh at 3★ hotel/camp
All transfers & sightseeing by private car
Pick-up from Dehradun & drop at Haridwar Railway Station
exclusions: Entry fees, ropeway, or extra activities
important-notes: Rafting depends on weather & river conditions
Carry comfortable shoes & clothes for rafting/trekking

title: Phu Quoc Island Getaway
description: Dive into the best of Phu Quoc, Vietnam’s premier beach destination. From coral-filled waters and stunning beaches to wildlife encounters and a world-class theme park — this itinerary is a perfect tropical combo of relaxation and adventure.
subtitle: 3 Nights 4 Days | Island Hopping, Safari & Theme Park Fun
para: Island Hopping • Safari • Theme Park Fun – All in One Tropical Escape

overview.subtitle: A Tropical Combo of Adventure & Relaxation
overview.description-1: Snorkel in turquoise waters, explore vibrant coral reefs, relax on stunning beaches, and dive into wildlife encounters and thrilling theme park rides.
overview.description-2: This package combines natural beauty with entertainment for an unforgettable Phu Quoc experience.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Phu Quoc – Welcome to Paradise
itinerary.para: Arrive at Phu Quoc International Airport, where our representative will meet you and escort you to your hotel. After check-in, the day is at leisure. You may unwind at the beach, stroll through local markets, or enjoy the evening sunset.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Full-Day 4 Island Tour by Speedboat with Lunch
itinerary.para: After breakfast, embark on a spectacular day trip exploring the most beautiful islands in the south of Phu Quoc. Snorkel, relax, and enjoy a seafood lunch.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Vinpearl Safari & VinWonders Theme Park
itinerary.para: Enjoy a full day exploring Vietnam’s largest wildlife park and one of its biggest theme parks, perfect for all ages.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Departure from Phu Quoc
itinerary.para: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to Phu Quoc Airport for departure.

inclusions: 03 Nights Accommodation in a 3-Star Hotel in Phu Quoc
Full-Day 4 Island Tour by Speedboat with Seafood Lunch (SIC)
